name: discovery-to-proposal-engine-plugin
description: Enterprise-grade staged multi-agent pipeline with contextual handoff (DAG) that ingests raw client discovery notes, meeting transcripts, and project briefings to engineer an exhaustive, dense, analytical technical-commercial pre-proposal dossier (DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md). Strictly prohibits slide decks or superficial summaries, orchestrating Stage 1 Problem & Scope Alignment, Stage 2 Solutions Architecture & Technical Risk Audit, Stage 3 Engineering Estimation (T-Shirt & Analogy), Stage 4 Agile Staffing & Milestone Scheduling, Stage 5 Commercial Governance & Contractual Risk Mitigation, led by the Lead Pre-Sales Orchestrator.
suggestedPrompts: Run the discovery-to-proposal pipeline on these client meeting notes to generate DOSSIE_TECNICO_PRE_PROPOSTA.md
Ingest this discovery transcript and execute the 5-stage pre-sales engineering DAG with contextual handoff
Analyze the problem statement, business metrics, and enforce strict in-scope vs out-of-scope boundaries for this discovery briefing
Audit technical architecture, integrations, legacy ERP dependencies, and evaluate Phase 0 Inception requirements for this project
Decompose the discovery requirements into 5-8 macro-epics and apply analogy T-shirt sizing with explicit uncertainty buffers
Design the optimal engineering squad topology with 75-80% utilization and map out delivery milestones
Structure the commercial governance framework, change request protocol, client acceptance SLAs, and tacit approval terms
Validate this pre-proposal technical dossier against all 8 mandatory sections, anti-slide rules, and engineering standards
